subject: maths
question: The cost price of an article is 72% of the marked price. The profit percentage after allowing a discount of 6% on the marked price is (rounded off to 2 decimal places):
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (C.P) = 72% marked price (M.P)

Discount% = 6%

**Formula used:**

If discount = D% then

Selling price (S.P) = M.P × (100 - D)%

Profit = S.P - C.P

Profit% = (profit × 100)/C.P 

**Calculation:**

⇒ C.P = 72% × M.P

⇒ C.P/M.P = 72/100

So, C.P = 72 and M.P = 100

Selling price (S.P) = 100 × (100 - 6)%

⇒ 100 × 94% = Rs.94

Profit% = {(94 -72) × 100}/72

⇒ (22 × 100)/72

⇒ 275/9 = 30.55 ≈ 30.56%

**∴ The correct answer is 30.56%.**
